messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: prod-west-1 GPU queue surge detected -> autoscaler failing to attach new nodes. queue_growth=+4200 reqs/min, drop rate increasing. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
maya (oncall): I'm on it, paging SREs and infra. Any customer hits?
linda (cs): Some paying customers reported 429s and slow responses ~5m ago, CS triage started.
alex (sre): Looking at queue metrics — pods pending on GPU nodes, ClusterAutoscaler logs show repeated AttachNotAllowed errors.
devon (infra): On ASG side seeing new instances boot but entering NotReady then shortly terminating. Suspect bootloop on AMI or user-data.
sam (eng-runtime): Recent launch-template rev v42 rolled yesterday night with kernel param tweak. Could be incompatible nvidia drivers.
maya (oncall): Can someone grab a failing node kubelet log? I can run quick checks.
alex (sre): Got one node name: gpu-pool-7q2b. `kubectl describe node gpu-pool-7q2b` shows kubelet crashloop: `failed to start kubelet: error initializing cgroup` and then systemd restart.
devon (infra): On the instance console I see `modprobe nvidia` failing with unknown symbol. AMI build might have mismatched driver/kernel.
sam (eng-runtime): That explains kubelet unhappy -> node NotReady -> autoscaler thinks attach failed and terminates. Autoscaler log: `FailedToRegisterNewNode: node kubelet not registering` repeated.
maya (oncall): We need a mitigation path: 1) stop autoscaler from terminating new instances, 2) roll back launch-template to previous AMI, 3) scale up manually if needed. Opinions?
alex (sre): For (1) we can set ASG desired capacity + increase cooldown and temporarily suspend autoscaler scale-down/terminate policy. I can run `aws autoscaling set-instance-health` but better to pause ClusterAutoscaler reconcile loop.
devon (infra): I can patch the LaunchTemplate to point to last-known-good AMI (lt v41). Rolling a new ASG version will be slow. Alternative: force attach current instances to SG and mark them healthy to avoid termination while we fix AMI.
maya (oncall): @devon please pause ClusterAutoscaler: `kubectl scale deployment cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system --replicas=0` and set ASG desired to +3 to buy time.
devon (infra): Doing that now. `kubectl scale deployment cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system --replicas=0` -> DONE.
deploy-bot: cluster-autoscaler scaled to 0 replicas by maya (oncall) at 03:42:10 UTC.
alex (sre): Increasing ASG desired capacity: `aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-prod-west1 --desired-capacity 6` -> requested.
maya (oncall): Trying to bring up nodes with previous LT: `aws ec2 run-instances --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-abc123,Version=41 --count 3`
devon (infra): Launched v41 instances, they booting. kubectl shows new nodes registering.
sam (eng-runtime): I'm watching driver install logs via cloud-init: v41 includes matching nvidia driver, modules load OK. Nodes become Ready.
linda (cs): CS: customers on one large account seeing degraded throughput; we advised retry and are opening incident SR. Will update status page.
maya (oncall): We're seeing queue drain on GPU pool now, request backlog decreasing. Drop rate decreasing from 7% -> 0.5% over 6 minutes.
alex (sre): Recommend keeping autoscaler paused until we fully rollback LT and confirm stable for 30m. Also create an IAM-safe rollback plan for future.
sam (eng-runtime): Creating a patch to the node bootstrap to be more defensive if driver load fails -> fall back to debugging mode rather than immediate kubelet restart. Will PR.
devon (infra): I'll run a targeted instance replacement to swap older launch-template in ASG and attach policy. Then re-enable autoscaler.
maya (oncall): Handing off to alex for extended mitigation window. I'm stepping off-call in 10m. @alex take over and update timeline and customer impact notes.
alex (sre): Taking over. Notes: root cause = LT v42 AMI with mismatched NVIDIA drivers -> kubelet crashloop -> new nodes NotReady -> ClusterAutoscaler perceives failure and terminates instances -> capacity exhaustion. Impact: transient 429s and elevated latency for some customers in prod-west-1 for ~18 minutes.
linda (cs): Logged incident with affected customers; proactively offering credits for any repeated retries.
maya (oncall): Thanks team. One last ask: add a postmortem checklist item to verify GPU AMI compatibility before LT rollouts.
sam (eng-runtime): Will add an automated smoke test on boot that validates nvidia modules and kubelet healthy before promoting LT.
devon (infra): ASG LT version rolled back to v41; cluster-autoscaler will be scaled back up after stability window.
alex (sre): Re-enabling cluster-autoscaler in 30m if no regressions. For now leave desired capacity at safe margin.
linda (cs): Notifying customers of mitigation and ETA for autoscaler re-enable.
deploy-bot: cluster-autoscaler scaled to 1 replicas by alex (sre) at 04:12:05 UTC (scheduled, pending checks).
alex (sre): Closing immediate page. Will file postmortem and link to this thread. If further alerts fire, re-open pager. :white_check_mark:
